raw:
name: Access request
description: Something only a FLOP operator can grant or remove — an allowlist entry, an operator quota, a gateway allowance, a private endpoint.
title: "access: "
labels: ["status:triage", "type:question"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: >-
        This issue is public. Send only public values: addresses and hostnames.
        Never paste a seed, account.json, .env, keystore, private key, bearer or API key. Questions
        the docs answer go to [ask.flop.finance](https://ask.flop.finance); devnet miners need no
        request while automatic sponsorship has room.
  - type: dropdown
    id: request
    attributes:
      label: Request
      options:
        - testnet miner sponsor allowlist entry
        - operator key quota (several miners)
        - gateway allowance
        - private endpoint
        - remove a retired host's access
        - other
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: network
    attributes:
      label: Network
      options:
        - devnet
        - testnet
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: identifiers
    attributes:
      label: Public identifiers
      description: >-
        The SS58 address (miner account or operator key), or hostname or DNS name the request
        is for.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: details
    attributes:
      label: Details
      description: >-
        GPU model and count for a miner, how many miners an operator key should cover, or the
        sponsor or gateway response you got (e.g. the 403 or 429 text).
    validations:
      required: false
